description: This file defines a custom view class 'SlidingTabStrip', which extends LinearLayout to create a custom tab indicator component with features such as indicator coloring, dividers, and selection handling for use in tabbed interfaces.
external_methods: blendColors(int color1, int color2, float ratio)

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom view extending LinearLayout for rendering tab indicators with customizable colors, dividers, and selection highlighting. It handles drawing underlines, selection indicators, and separator lines between tabs.

classes.name: SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: Inner class implementing TabColorizer interface to provide colors for indicators and dividers, supporting setting multiple colors for dynamic tab coloring.

methods.name: SlidingTabStrip
methods.description: Constructors initializing the custom view, setting default styles and paints based on theme density and attributes.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Assigns a custom TabColorizer for coloring tabs.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the selection indicator, clearing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Sets colors for the dividers between tabs, clearing any custom colorizer.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset based on page scroll.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles custom drawing of selection indicator, underline, and dividers on the canvas.
